response.sql:
WITH album_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(15,8)) / Milliseconds) as album_rate,
    COUNT(*) as track_count
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(album_rate) as overall_mean
  FROM album_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(album_stats.album_rate) as avg_rate,
  AVG(album_stats.track_count) as avg_track_count,
  AVG(album_stats.album_rate - mean_rate.overall_mean) as avg_excess
FROM album_stats
CROSS JOIN mean_rate
WHERE album_stats.album_rate > mean_rate.overall_mean

assumptions.assumption: Track count for each album is the count of tracks with non-null Bytes in that album, not the total count of all tracks (which may include tracks with null Bytes)

alternatives.interpretation: Track count refers to the total number of all tracks in the album, including those with null Bytes
alternatives.sql:
WITH album_rate_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(15,8)) / Milliseconds) as album_rate
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
all_album_track_counts AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    COUNT(*) as total_track_count
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
album_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ars.AlbumId,
    ars.album_rate,
    aatc.total_track_count
  FROM album_rate_stats ars
  JOIN all_album_track_counts aatc ON COALESCE(ars.AlbumId, -999999) = COALESCE(aatc.AlbumId, -999999)
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(album_rate) as overall_mean
  FROM album_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(album_stats.album_rate) as avg_rate,
  AVG(album_stats.total_track_count) as avg_track_count,
  AVG(album_stats.album_rate - mean_rate.overall_mean) as avg_excess
FROM album_stats
CROSS JOIN mean_rate
WHERE album_stats.album_rate > mean_rate.overall_mean
